title: Lekalo PHP Routes Map
description: Closed contract for the deterministic routes map sidecar the PHP Laravel routes emitter writes beside its artifacts (issue #60). The sidecar is the custody receipt and the exported link table: it binds every governed route to its endpoint symbol, operation id, controller and request symbols, declared error-to-status projection, auth binding, scenario references, and the emitted OpenAPI document pointer, and carries the complete path-sorted artifact inventory with content digests. The sidecar never contains declaration byte ranges - source-map documents are a separate `declarations` shape, and this sidecar's `.map.json` suffix therefore binds nothing in the core source-map ingester. The map's own file digest belongs to the ownership manifest, never inside the hashed content.

digests.description: The exact input digests this map was derived from; any change invalidates the derivation.

transport.description: The canonical transport-http attachment bytes the routes were projected from.

typesInput.description: The bound types input document digest.

operationsInput.description: The bound operations input document digest.

openapi.description: The canonical OpenAPI projection bytes emitted verbatim as `openapi.json`.

routes.description: One entry per governed route, sorted by id.

artifacts.description: The complete artifact inventory, path-sorted, every file the plan covers (emitted bytes under the custody root; declared-only maintained entries for checked records carry a `declared: true` role and no digest).

operationId.description: The effective transport operation id: the deterministic camel transform of the endpoint id, or the declared override.

operation.description: The invoked command or query symbol.

name.description: The generated Laravel route name (the operation id).

controller.description: The generated thin controller symbol and path (managed mode).

action.description: The public action method name (the operation id).

request.description: The generated typed request-binding symbol and path, for routes with a declared body.

entry.description: The invoked operation entrypoint: managed derives the generated handler FQN; checked carries the declared existing entry.

middleware.description: The attached middleware spellings, sorted; empty when no scheme mapping declared one.

success.description: The declared success projection: status and the optional body mode.

errors.description: The declared per-error status projection, sorted by error id.

errorDefaults.description: The declared category defaults (validation, auth, conflict, not-found, domain, infrastructure).

auth.description: The declared security binding, when the endpoint declares one.

links.description: The exported trace links: endpoint symbol, operation symbol, controller/request symbols, scenario references, and the OpenAPI operation pointer.

openapiPointer.description: The JSON pointer of this route's operation inside the emitted `openapi.json`.

role.description: The bounded artifact role (routes-file, controller, request, error-map, envelope, openapi, classmap, map).

digest.description: Present for generated artifacts; absent for declared-only maintained entries.

fqn.description: The primary PHP symbol of the artifact, when one exists.

declared.description: True for a checked record's declared-only entry (no bytes are owned).
